text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho drew near. Determined to 
claim the spotlight, T.M. Opera O honed 
her skills alongside Meisho Doto—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Narita Top Road conveyed her 
deep respect and competitive fire straight 
to Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Touched by the burning passion of those 
rivals—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside Admire Vega, too, something was 
beginning to sprout bit by bit.
